caption.purpose: Level captions, percent change, legend keys, hints.

shadows.purpose: Detail panel floating beside the grid.

components.css: .ds-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 160px); gap: 12px; } .ds-cell { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 14px 16px 16px; min-height: 132px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line, #D9E4EE); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #1B2430); transition: border-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-cell:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #B9CBDB); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(23,74,124,.08); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6FA3D6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sym { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; } .ds-px { font-weight: 400; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-3, #5F6F82); } .ds-word { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.25; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--ink-2, #44546A); } .ds-one { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink-3, #5F6F82); white-space: pre-line; } .ds-long { background: #E7F4EC; border-color: #A9D3B9; } .ds-long .ds-word { color: #1F7A47; } .ds-short { background: #FBE9E7; border-color: #EBB4AD; } .ds-short .ds-word { color: #B42318; } .ds-hold { background: #E6EFFA; border-color: #AFC8E6; } .ds-hold .ds-word { color: #2563A8; } .ds-cell[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: #174A7C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #174A7C, 0 6px 18px rgba(23,74,124,.12); }

components.css: .ds-detail { width: 400px; box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 22px 24px 24px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line, #D9E4EE); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(23,74,124,.07); font: 400 15px/1.6 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #1B2430); } .ds-detail p { margin: 0; } .ds-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; } .ds-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-head span { color: var(--ink-3, #5F6F82); } .ds-badge { justify-self: start; padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background: #E9EEF3; color: var(--ink-2, #44546A); } .ds-b-long { background: #1F7A47; color: #fff; } .ds-levels { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin: 0; } .ds-levels div { background: var(--ground, #F4F8FB); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; } .ds-levels dt { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3, #5F6F82); } .ds-levels dd { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-levels small { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-3, #5F6F82); } .ds-size { background: var(--office-tint, #E4EEF7); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; }

components.css: .ds-rule { max-width: 640px; padding: 22px 24px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line, #D9E4EE); border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #1B2430); } .ds-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-top h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-verdict { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-pass { background: #174A7C; color: #fff; } .ds-fail { background: #EDF0F3; color: #44546A; } .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(92px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; margin-top: 18px; } .ds-yr { border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 10px 9px; min-height: 86px; display: grid; align-content: space-between; animation: ds-rise .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards; } .ds-yr b { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-yr span { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-yr small { font-size: 12px; } .ds-off { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #F1F4F7 0 7px, #E2E8EE 7px 9px); color: #44546A; } .ds-off span { font-weight: 500; } @keyframes ds-rise { from { transform: translateY(10px); opacity: .35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-yr { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is a public weather bulletin for trading: an office-blue masthead with issue time and next issue, one plain sentence for today (今日行動預報), a grid of per-coin forecasts, and the forecast's own verified track record (預報準確度) set out like a rainfall chart. It borrows the calm, civic voice of the 中央氣象署 forecast that its one reader already trusts: pale sky ground, white panels, a single institutional blue, and colour that only speaks when there is something to do.

Density is moderate and desktop-first. The answer sits at the top in heavy type; evidence lives one step below in lighter, smaller, tabular figures. Waiting (觀望) is rendered at the same size and weight as an actionable call, so "do nothing" reads as a forecast, not an empty state. The page is light throughout; an all-dark, low-contrast page is a confirmed rejection (PRODUCT.md accessibility note).
keyCharacteristics: Pale sky ground (#F4F8FB) with white panels and hairline blue-grey borders; one deep office blue for authority.
Signal colours (green, red, blue, amber) are reserved per state and never decorative.
Year-by-year verification drawn as a graded colour band, like a rainfall map, with hatching for years the rule was not allowed to trade.
Noto Sans TC throughout with tabular numerals; weight 900 carries the answers.
Flat panels; soft blue-tinted shadow only on interactive or sticky surfaces.

rules.name: The Reserved Signal Rule
rules.body: Green means 做多 now, red means 放空 now, holding blue means a position is open, amber means warning. No other element may use these state tokens (the year scale has its own peach-to-brown steps), and waiting never borrows one: 觀望 stays ink-2 on white.

rules.name: The Rainfall Scale Rule
rules.body: Verification results use the blue-to-brown scale, never green and red, so a good past year can never be mistaken for a signal to act today.

rules.name: The Hatch Means Not Allowed Rule
rules.body: The 135° hatch (hatch-light 7px, hatch-dark 2px) marks only years the walk-forward rule was not allowed to trade, and the legend always says so in words.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number on the page is tabular; prices, percentages and counts must align in columns and not jitter on refresh.

rules.name: The Heavy Answer Rule
rules.body: Weight 900 belongs to answers (headline sentence, forecast word, coin title, year value) and section heads. Explanations never go above 700.

rules.name: The Blue Air Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always blue-tinted, blurred, and offset straight down. Rule cards, settings and tables stay flat.

dos: Do keep the page light: sky ground, white panels, ink text.
Do give 觀望 the same forecast-word size and weight as 做多 and 放空.
Do colour a coin cell only by its current state: long, short, hold, or plain.
Do draw verification on the eight-step blue-to-brown scale, each step with its own chosen text colour, and hatch years that were not allowed to trade.
Do keep every number tabular and right-aligned in tables.
Do tint any shadow with office blue (rgba(23, 74, 124, ≤.12)) and keep it on interactive or sticky surfaces.
Do use the house ease cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) for state changes and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't use green or red anywhere except a 做多 / 放空 call that is valid now.
Don't use green or red on the verification scale.
Don't use the hatch for anything other than "not allowed to trade".
Don't build an all-dark or low-contrast page.
Don't turn the forecast into a stat-card dashboard or a wall of tables; the sentence and the grid come first, tables sit below them.
